description.value:
A rare few fighters find that their connection to the Force doesn't call them toward meditation or diplomacy, but toward violence given wings. The Adept Specialist fuses a fighter's discipline with a trickle of Force sensitivity, using it to accelerate their body far beyond what muscle alone allows.

Weaving in and out of melee in short, ferocious bursts, they strike before an enemy can react and vanish before a counterblow lands. To watch an Adept fight is to watch someone who is never quite where you expect them to be.
